fact: The IMPULSE study (Nov 2022-Jul 2024) found DHIS2 in use as the routine health information system in central and subnational data offices in the Central African Republic.

A DHIS2 Community poster by the CAR health ministry's SNIS team states DHIS2 was adopted as the national platform for the Système National d'Information Sanitaire and deployed in all 35 health districts.
The poster states report completeness rose from 52% in 2020 to over 85% in 2025.

HISP Rwanda says clinical data from the e-SENI hospital EMR is automatically structured and integrated into national health information systems, including DHIS2-powered platforms, with automated reporting to DHIS2.

Institut Pasteur de Bangui says DHIS2 is the central tool for collecting, managing and analysing health data in the Central African Republic, deployed since 2021 and mainly carrying aggregate data compiled periodically by health facilities.

HISP WCA says Central African Republic began implementing DHIS2 for its national health information system in 2022, first in five pilot districts, with training extended to all districts in March 2022, and delays, power and internet cuts hampering it.
